facts.mainText: Moving from Calgary to Vancouver?The Calgary–Vancouver corridor is one of Canada's busiest long-distance moving routes. Whether you're relocating for work, moving closer to family, or planning a major move between provinces, Purely Canadian Movers has the experience and infrastructure to get your belongings there safely.As agents of Great Canadian Van Lines, we combine the reach of a national carrier with the personal accountability of a family-owned business. Your move is coordinated through Purely Canadian Movers and the Great Canadian Van Lines agent network, with clear documentation, Declared Value Protection options, and no broker-style handoffs to unknown movers.We also handle the reverse: Vancouver to Calgary moves are equally common, and we provide the same level of service regardless of direction.Calgary–Vancouver Route at a Glance↔Distance~1,000 kmCalgary to Vancouver◷Estimated transit time4–13 daysDepending on shipment size$Typical cost range$1,800–$13,000+Studio to 4+ bedroom homeWhat Makes a Calgary–Vancouver Move UniqueDistance and logistics: At roughly 1000 km, this is an interprovincial long-distance move. Scheduling, weight estimates, and delivery windows all require more precision than a shorter haul. Our team walks you through every detail before your move date.Vancouver's climate: Vancouver's mild, wet winters mean we protect electronics and wood furniture from moisture during transit. Summer moves are popular but require early scheduling.Elevator bookings and condo rules: Both Calgary and Vancouver have large condo populations with strict elevator booking windows and loading dock rules. We coordinate with building management in advance to avoid delays on move day.Employment-driven relocations: Many Calgary-to-Vancouver moves are corporate or employment-driven. We work with individuals and HR departments to accommodate tight timelines and provide the documentation needed for relocation reimbursement.Tips for Moving to VancouverVancouver’s Housing MarketVancouver is one of Canada’s most expensive housing markets. Research neighbourhoods carefully — areas like East Vancouver, Burnaby, and Coquitlam offer more affordable options while remaining close to the city.Rainy Season PreparationVancouver’s rainy season runs October through April. If moving in winter, protect your belongings with extra waterproof wrapping. We take precautions to protect furniture and boxes from moisture during loading and unloading.Update Your BC Driver’s LicenceYou have 90 days after establishing BC residency to exchange your Alberta driver’s licence for a BC licence at an ICBC driver licensing office. You’ll also need BC auto insurance through ICBC.No More Alberta Tax AdvantageMoving from Alberta (no provincial sales tax) to BC (7% PST + 5% GST = 12% combined) means higher taxes on most purchases. Factor this into your cost-of-living comparison.The Rocky Mountain DriveThe Trans-Canada Highway through the Rockies is one of Canada’s most scenic routes. Our drivers are experienced with mountain driving conditions, including winter chain requirements on certain passes.Why Choose Purely Canadian MoversFamily-owned since 1991 — over 30 years of long-distance experienceAgents of Great Canadian Van Lines — national network, local careNo moving brokers or random subcontractors — your crew handles your move start to finishBBB Accredited with a proven track recordTransparent pricing — no hidden fees or surprise chargesFull packing, unpacking, and storage options availableWatch out for low-ball quotes. Some movers advertise unusually low rates for long-distance moves, then add fuel surcharges, stair fees, or reweigh charges after your belongings are loaded. Always ask for a written estimate and confirm what is included before signing anything.How Your Calgary–Vancouver Move Works1Free EstimateCall or fill out our online form. We assess your inventory and provide a detailed, no-obligation quote.2Pack & LoadOur crew arrives on moving day, carefully packs your belongings (if requested), and loads the truck.3Interprovincial TransitYour shipment is coordinated through Purely Canadian Movers and the Great Canadian Van Lines agent network, with clear documentation, Declared Value Protection options, and no broker-style handoffs to unknown movers.4Delivery & UnloadWe deliver to your new Vancouver address and unload everything to the room of your choice."We moved from Calgary to Vancouver last spring and the whole process was seamless. The crew was professional, everything arrived on time and in perfect condition. I'd recommend Purely Canadian Movers to anyone making this move."— Michael T., Calgary to Vancouver

faq.question: How long has Purely Canadian Movers been in business?
faq.answer: Purely Canadian Movers has been serving Metro Vancouver since 1991 — over 30 years of family-owned moving expertise.

faq.question: Do you use subcontractors?
faq.answer: No. we do not operate like a moving broker or hand moves to unknown third-party movers. Every move is handled exclusively by our own trained, vetted employees from start to finish.

faq.question: What areas do you serve?
faq.answer: We serve all of Metro Vancouver and the Lower Mainland, including Vancouver, Coquitlam, Surrey, Burnaby, North Vancouver, Langley, Richmond, and New Westminster. We also offer long-distance, cross-country, Canada–USA, and overseas moves.

faq.question: Do you offer free estimates?
faq.answer: Yes. We provide free, no-obligation moving estimates. You can request one online or call us at 1-877-485-6683.

faq.question: Are you BBB Accredited?
faq.answer: Yes, Purely Canadian Movers is BBB Accredited with an excellent rating, reflecting our commitment to honest, professional service.

faq.question: Do you offer storage services?
faq.answer: Yes. We offer secure short-term and long-term storage at our Coquitlam facility with flexible terms and competitive monthly rates.

faq.question: Can you help with packing?
faq.answer: Yes. We offer full-service and partial packing using professional-grade materials. We also offer unpacking and removal of packing materials at your new home.

faq.question: Do you move offices and businesses?
faq.answer: Yes. We specialize in office and corporate relocations of all sizes, with weekend and after-hours moves available to minimize business disruption.

Our drivers are experienced on this corridor year-round, including winter conditions through Rogers Pass and Kicking Horse Canyon.Calgary's climate: Calgary's Chinook winds can create dramatic temperature swings in a single day. Contact your building manager at least 2 weeks before your move date — we can help coordinate.Plan for Calgary's Climate SwingsCalgary's Chinook winds can cause dramatic temperature swings — from -20°C to +10°C in a single day. If moving in winter, we protect wood furniture, electronics, and temperature-sensitive items during transit through the Rockies.Update Your Alberta Health CardYou have 90 days after establishing residency to apply for an Alberta Health Card. Visit an Alberta Registry office with proof of identity and residency. Don't forget to cancel your BC MSP coverage.Understand Calgary's NeighbourhoodsCalgary's inner-city communities (Kensington, Inglewood, Beltline) have older housing stock with narrower streets. Suburban areas (Tuscany, Cranston, Mahogany) are newer with easier truck access.
